caption: The rule S → NP VP PP is the only one longer than two symbols, so it splits into S → NP X1 and X1 → VP PP; every other rule already has the CNF shape and the grammar grows from 10 rules to 11.

spec.title: Rewriting a rule into CNF
spec.aria: A six-step flow from the rule S → NP VP PP, through adding the new nonterminal X1 and two binary rules, to a CNF grammar of 11 rules.
